output.review_comment: The tie-breaking logic change (reversing headcount preference and adding index-based tie-breaking) is significant and lacks proper justification. This change contradicts standard D'Hondt methodology and could represent test-specific logic rather than docstring-compliant behavior. Please clarify: (1) the full docstring requirements for this function, (2) why the headcount preference was reversed, (3) how the tie-breaking aligns with documented behavior rather than just passing tests.
